verses.sanskrit: वैशम्पायन उवाच । एवमुक्ते तु सव्रीडः सुशर्माऽऽसीद‌धोमुखः । स मुक्तोऽभ्येत्य राजानमभिवाद्य प्रतस्थिवान् ॥१॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said Thus addressed Susharma was filled with shame and bent down his head. And liberated and bowing to the king he went away.

verses.sanskrit: विसृज्य तु सुशर्माणं पाण्डवास्ते हतद्विषः । स्वबाहुबलसंपन्ना हीनिषेवा यतव्रताः । संग्रामशिरसो मध्ये तां रात्रिं सुखिनोऽवसन् ॥२॥
verses.english: Having released Susharma, the Pandavas, then enemies slain, endowed with the strength of arms, observant of vows, and modest, passed that night happily in the midst of the battle-field. Then Virata honoured, with wealth and respect, those mighty car-warriors, the of Kunti, who were gifted with superhuman prowess.

verses.sanskrit: ततो विराटः कौन्तेयानतिमानुषविक्रमान् । अर्चयामास वित्तेन मानेन च महारथान् ॥३॥
विराट उवाच । यथैव मम रत्नानि युष्माकं तानि वै तथा । कार्यं कुरुत वै सर्वे यथाकामं यथासुखम् ॥४॥
verses.english: sons Virata said All these my jewels are as much mine as yours; do you all work as you like and as may conduce to your happiness.

verses.sanskrit: ददाम्यलङ्कृताः कन्या वसूनि विविधानि च । मनसश्चाप्यभिप्रेतं युद्धे शत्रुनिबर्हणाः ॥५॥
verses.english: O repressors of foes in battle, I shall center upon you women adorned with ornaments, plentiful riches and other things that you may like.

verses.sanskrit: युष्माकं विक्रमादद्य मुक्तोऽहं स्वस्तिमानिह । तस्माद्भवन्तो मत्स्यानामीश्वराः सर्व एव हि ॥६॥
verses.english: By your prowess today I have been saved from peril. I am now crowned with victory. Do you all become the kings of Matsya's.

verses.sanskrit: वैशम्पायन उवाच । तथेतिवादिनं मत्स्यं कौरवेयाः पृथक् पृथक् । ऊचुः प्राञ्जलयः सर्वे युधिष्ठिरपुरागमाः ॥७॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said Those Kauravas, headed by Yudhishthira, with folded heads, said each severally to the king of the Matsya who had addressed them thus.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिनन्दाम ते वाक्यं सर्वं चैव विशाम्पते । एतेनैव प्रतीताः स्म यत्त्वं मुक्तोऽद्य शत्रुभिः ॥८॥
verses.english: O king, we have been perfectly pleased with what you have said. It is a matter of gratification to us that you have been released from the enemies.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽब्रवीत् प्रतिमना मत्स्यराजो युधिष्ठिरम् । पुनरेव महाबाहुर्विराटो राजसत्तमः ॥९॥
verses.english: Then the mighty armed, Virata, the king of Matsya's, the foremost of monarchs, again delightedly said to Yudhishthira.

verses.sanskrit: एहि त्वामभिषेक्ष्यामि मत्स्यराजस्तु नो भवान् । मनसश्चाप्यभिप्रेतं यथेष्टं भुवि दुर्लभम् । तत्तेऽहं सम्प्रदास्यामि सर्वमर्हति नो भवान् ॥१०॥
verses.english: Come, I shall install you and be the king of us, the Matsya's. Whatever you desire in mind, any thing, even though rare on earth,

verses.sanskrit: रत्नानि गाः सुवर्णं च मणिमुक्तमथापि च । वैयाघ्रपद्य विप्रेन्द्र सर्वथैव नमोऽस्तु ते ॥११॥
verses.english: I shall confer upon you all-jewels, kine, gold, pearls, jems and all; you deserve every thing.

verses.sanskrit: त्वत्कृते ह्यद्य पश्यामि राज्यं सन्तानमेव च । यतश्च जातसंरम्भो न च शत्रुवशं गतः ॥१२॥
verses.english: I bow to you, it is for you that once more today I see my kingdom and children.

verses.sanskrit: ततो युधिष्ठिरो मत्स्यं पुनरेवाभ्यभाषत । प्रतिनन्दामि ते वाक्यं मनोज्ञं मत्स्य भाषसे ॥१३॥
verses.english: Through you, afflicted with fear I did not pass into the hands of the enemies." Yudhishthira then again said to the king of Matsya's.

verses.sanskrit: आनृशंस्यपरो नित्यं सुसुखी सततं भव । गच्छन्तु दूतास्त्वरितं नगरं तव पार्थिव ॥१४॥
verses.english: O king of Matsya, we highly relish the delightful words you have given vent to. Being humane towards all do you live happily ever and anon.
verses.bhavadeepa: यतो निगृहीतः जातसंरम्भो जातभयोऽपि त्वद्बलान्न च शत्रुवशंगतोऽस्मि ॥१३॥

verses.sanskrit: सुहृदां प्रियमाख्यातुं घोषयन्तु च ते जयम् । ततस्तद्वचनान्मत्स्यो दूतान्राजा समादिशत् ॥१५॥
verses.english: O king, let emissaries speedily go to your city, to communicate this pleasant tidings to your friends and announce your victory.

verses.sanskrit: आचक्षध्वं पुरं गत्वा संग्रामविजयं मम । कुमार्यः समलंकृत्य पर्यागच्छन्तु मे पुरात् ॥१६॥
verses.english: At his words the king of Matsya's dispatched his emissaries, saying: “Going to my city do you announce my victory.

verses.sanskrit: वादित्राणि च सर्वाणि गणिकाश्च स्वलंकृताः । एतां चाज्ञां ततः श्रुत्वा राज्ञा मत्स्येन नोदिताः । तामाज्ञां शिरसा कृत्वा प्रस्थिता हृष्टमानसाः ॥१७॥
verses.english: Hearing this his command and being thus addressed by the Matsya king, they, placing his command on their heads, delightedly went away.

verses.sanskrit: ते गत्वा तत्र तां रात्रिमथ सूर्योदयं प्रति । विराटस्य पुराभ्याशे दूता जयमघोषयन् ॥१८॥
verses.english: Going to the city that very night they announced, at the hour of sun-rise, the victory of the king.
